per_hop.query:
SELECT ?show ?host (COUNT(?hostedShow) AS ?totalShowsHosted)
WHERE {
  ?appearance wdt:P161 wd:Q106935670;    # Paul Melba's involvement in the show
              wdt:P144 ?show.             # The show in which he appeared
  ?show wdt:P31 wd:Q15416;               # The show is a television show
        wdt:P495 wd:Q145.                 # The show is British
  ?show wdt:P840 ?host.                  # The host of the show
  ?host p:P106 ?statement.               # Fetch all shows hosted by the host
  ?statement ps:P106 wd:Q33999.          # Host profession
  ?hostedShow wdt:P840 ?host.            # Shows hosted by the host
}
GROUP BY ?show ?host
HAVING (COUNT(?hostedShow) = 23)
